title: Deep-sea creature design sheet
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Habitats and blocking sound (Blue Abyss and Can We Block Sound?)
source: Seeded from science/y4 lesson 29 (Deep-sea creature design sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 29: Adapted for ocean life. To understand how ocean animals are adapted to survive in their habitat

questions.q: How does a streamlined shape help a fish?
questions.a: It moves through water easily and fast
questions.model: Think about pushing through water. A smooth, pointed shape pushes less water out of the way. So the fish swims easily and fast.

questions.q: Which body part takes oxygen from water?

questions.a: No: it is a mammal that breathes air

questions.q: Design a new deep-sea creature. Label four adaptations and say how each helps it survive.
questions.a: Four labelled features, e.g. glowing lure (attracts prey), big eyes (sees faint light), large mouth, soft body (copes with pressure)
questions.model: Teacher draws an anglerfish outline and labels 'glowing lure: attracts prey in the dark'.

questions.q: Explain how camouflage helps both predators and prey.
questions.a: Prey hide from predators; predators sneak up unseen

questions.q: Why could a coral reef fish not survive in the deep sea?
questions.a: It is adapted to warm, bright water; the deep is cold, dark and high pressure

questions.q: Colours that help an animal hide are called...
Big question: why is a flatfish hard to see?
questions.a: Camouflage: it matches the sea bed so it hides from predators and ambushes prey.
